source_definition: The source title and structure scheme expand TTMSS as tris(trimethylsilyl)silane.
The source uses BA740 as a source-specific photoinitiator code.
Source figure label is the full common chemical name.
The source materials section defines DDFD as 4,4-dimethyldihydrofuran-2,3-dione and supplies registry number 13031-04-4.
The source defines IC2959 as the named water-soluble initiator and supplies its full chemical name and registry number in the materials section.
